scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,core,electron "bun run dev:renderer" "bun run dev:core" "bun run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ./dist/electron/electron/main/index.js
scripts.build: bun run type-check && vite build && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.type-check: bunx vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
